title: tehas limit --json
description: The object tehas limit --json prints, version 1: the limit the factory runs under. host/docs/api.md says what each field means. Every object is closed, so a field tehas adds must be added here too; a program that reads the object still accepts fields it does not know. tehas drain prints the same reading as its limit field, without api. test/json_contract_test.sh checks the samples beside this file against it.
